test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The man was repairing the tyres of his car.

options.text: The tyres of his car was being repaired by the man.
The tyres of his car were being repaired by the man.
The tyres of his car were been repaired by the man.
The tyres of his car were repaired by the man.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The tyres of his car were being repaired by the man."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Past Continuous Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Past Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + was/were + v1 + ing+ object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha was singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song was being sung by Esha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The man'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the tyres of his car'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'was repairing' will be changed into 'were being repairing'. 
 
• "The tyres of hiscar" is a plural subject so we must "were" with it.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The tyres of his car were being repaired by the man.*
